installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Installer ringan: hanya menyiapkan folder + (opsional) cloudflared dari rilis resmi Cloudflare.
# Tidak ada unduhan konfigurasi dari repo pihak ketiga. Gagal unduh cloudflared TIDAK menggagalkan install.
cd /mnt/server || exit 1
mkdir -p /mnt/server/webroot /mnt/server/logs /mnt/server/tmp

echo "[Bimxyz] Installing Cloudflare Tunnel client (optional)..."
CF_OK=1
ARCH="$(uname -m)"
case "$ARCH" in
    x86_64|amd64) CF_ARCH="amd64" ;;
    aarch64|arm64) CF_ARCH="arm64" ;;
    *) CF_ARCH=""; CF_OK=0 ;;
esac
if [ "$CF_OK" = "1" ]; then
    apk add --no-cache curl ca-certificates >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    curl -fL --retry 4 --retry-delay 2 --connect-timeout 20 \
        "https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases/latest/download/cloudflared-linux-${CF_ARCH}" \
        -o /mnt/server/cloudflared || CF_OK=0
fi
if [ "$CF_OK" = "1" ]; then
    chmod 0755 /mnt/server/cloudflared
    /mnt/server/cloudflared version >/mnt/server/logs/cloudflared-version.log 2>&1 || CF_OK=0
fi
if [ "$CF_OK" != "1" ]; then
    rm -f /mnt/server/cloudflared
    echo "[WARNING] cloudflared could not be installed. Laravel still works; Tunnel modes need a reinstall."
fi

echo "[SUCCESS] Laravel egg installation completed. Upload your Laravel project to /home/container/webroot (or fill Git Repo Address)."
exit 0

variables.name: Git Repo Address
variables.description: Optional HTTPS Git repository. Used when webroot is empty, or for auto-pull when it is already a Git repository.

variables.name: PHP-FPM Max Children
variables.description: Maximum simultaneous PHP-FPM workers. Default 5; tune to the server's RAM/CPU limit.

variables.name: Git Auto Pull
variables.description: 1 = pull --ff-only on startup for an existing Git repository.

variables.name: Create .env
variables.description: Create .env from .env.example if .env does not exist.

variables.name: Generate APP_KEY
variables.description: Generate a key when APP_KEY is empty.

variables.name: Composer Auto Install
variables.description: Install Composer dependencies when vendor/autoload.php is missing.

variables.name: Composer No Dev
variables.description: 1 = omit require-dev packages.

variables.name: Force Composer Install
variables.description: 1 = run composer install on every startup. Keep 0 for production.

variables.name: Extra Composer Packages
variables.description: Optional packages for composer require. Space-separated.

variables.name: Install Extra Composer On Start
variables.description: 1 = run composer require for Extra Composer Packages on startup.

variables.name: Storage Link
variables.description: Run php8 artisan storage:link --force.

variables.name: Run Migrations
variables.description: 1 = run php8 artisan migrate --force at startup.

variables.name: Laravel Optimize
variables.description: 1 = run php8 artisan optimize at startup.

variables.name: Clear Laravel Caches
variables.description: 1 = run optimize:clear before serving. Usually keep 0.

variables.name: OPcache
variables.description: Enable production OPcache settings when the image exposes the OPcache extension.

variables.name: OPcache Memory MB
variables.description: OPcache shared memory size.

variables.name: OPcache Validate Timestamps
variables.description: 1 = perubahan kode langsung terbaca (disarankan kalau file sering diupload/diedit). 0 = sedikit lebih cepat, tapi server harus di-restart setelah kode berubah.

variables.name: Queue Worker
variables.description: Start Laravel queue:work and restart it if the worker exits.

variables.name: Queue Sleep
variables.description: Queue worker sleep interval in seconds.

variables.name: Queue Tries
variables.description: Queue worker attempts.

variables.name: Queue Timeout
variables.description: Queue worker timeout in seconds.

variables.name: Laravel Scheduler
variables.description: Run schedule:run once per minute.

variables.name: PHP Upload Max Filesize
variables.description: PHP upload_max_filesize.

variables.name: PHP Post Max Size
variables.description: PHP post_max_size.

variables.description: PHP max_input_time in seconds.

variables.description: 1 = tulis access log Nginx ke logs/access.log (bisa membesar cepat). 0 = mati (default).
